description: This bar chart, titled “Health and Nutrition,” “Logistics,” and “Travel and Transportation,” displays stacked bar plots comparing two models, “MVS” (green) and “1-MVS” (blue), across three domains, with each domain containing two bars labeled “70B llama” and “8B llama.” The vertical axis is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, representing normalized values, while the horizontal axis lists the model and domain combinations. In each group of three bars, the “70B llama” bars are consistently taller than the “8B llama” bars, indicating higher overall values. Within each bar, the green “MVS” segment is consistently longer than the blue “1-MVS” segment, suggesting that the MVS component contributes more to the total value in each case. For example, in the “Health and Nutrition” group, the “70B llama” bar has an MVS value of approximately 0.6 and a 1-MVS value of approximately 0.4, while the “8B llama” bar has an MVS value of approximately 0.4 and a 1-MVS value of approximately 0.6. The bars are not sorted and are presented in a fixed order across the three domains. The chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating the color coding for the two models.
